statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  exact ∀ t : ℝ, 2 < t → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r), α.IsPrimitive →
    ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m →
    ∀ F : Finset (Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s),
    (∀ b ∈ F, b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive) →
    (∑ b ∈ F, ‖S α b.2 m‖ ^ t) ≤ C * ‖O m‖ ^ t

plain_statement.zh: 对所有实指数 t>2，一致控制跨导子的原始搭档 t 次矩。
plain_statement.en: Uniform superquadratic moments of primitive partners across all conductors.

brief.zh: #4245 处理 t=3。归一化后单项至多 1，故真正新增的是 2<t<3，对小系数的控制更强。若首特征局部平凡，分离平凡搭档并对剩余项使用 1/(p−2) 上界。若局部非平凡，对二次矩用最大值的 t−2 次幂；大素数应给出收缩，小素数保留在依赖 t 的常数中。
brief.en: PR #4245 gives t=3. After normalization the new range is 2<t<3. For a principal local row isolate its principal entry; the rest have cap 1/(p−2). For a nonprincipal row combine Parseval with the pointwise cap to the power t−2. Control the product uniformly in both conductors.
